results.question: What is the Enterprise Document RAG Chatbot according to the executive summary?
results.answer:
The Enterprise Document RAG Chatbot is an internal knowledge assistant that allows employees to ask natural-language questions and receive accurate, grounded answers pulled directly from company documents. Each answer is backed by a clickable source and page number, ensuring that nothing is taken on faith.

research reports, compliance filings - that are searched manually or not searched at all.

from company documents - each answer backed by a clickable source and page number, so

11. UI/UX Design Direction - "Doesn't Look Like AI"
A key product requirement is that the interface reads as a serious internal enterprise tool -
closer to Notion, Linear, or a professional knowledge base not a generic chatbot bubble UI
with a robot avatar and purple gradients.
11.1 Design Principles
No AIcliches: no robot/sparkle icons, no purple-to-blue gradients, no"Hi, I'm your AI
assistant i" copy.

FR-1O: System shall generate answers via LLM (OpenAI) constrained to cite sources
inline as([Document Name, p. X].
FR-11: System shall return "I don't have enough information in the provided documents"
when retrieval confidence is low, rather than fabricating an answer.
 FR-12: System shall maintain conversational memory (last N turns) to support follow-up
questions.
7.4 Backend (FastAPI)
FR-14: PosT /documents/upload accepts PDF files for ingestion.
FR-15: GET /documents - lists indexed documents with metadata.
FR-16: DELETE /documents/(id removes a document and its vectors from the index.
FR-17:GET /sessions/(id)/history-retrieves conversation history.
FR-18: GET /health system health/status endpoint.
7.5 Evaluation
FR-19: System shall run RAGAS evaluation (faithfulness,answer relevancy, context
precision, context recall) on a curated Q&A test set.

Security
Documents and vector store encrypted at rest; APIauthenticated (API key or SsO in
Phase 2)
Data Privacy
Nodocument content sent to third partiesbeyond the configured LLMprovider; PII
handlingdocumented
Auditability
Every generatedanswer is traceableto exact sourcechunksused
Maintainability
Modularpipeline (ingestion /retrieval /generation are independently swappable)
Observability
Structured logging of queries, retrieval hits, latencies, and evaluation scores

Human tone in copy: system messages read like a knowledgeable colleague ("No
mention of this in the indexed documents - try rephrasing or check with HR directly")
ratherthan assistant-speak.
Static, sturdy layout: minimal animation; only subtle transitions (fade-in for streaming
text, no bouncing avatars).
11.2 Key Screens
1. Workspace Home - document library grid with upload status, last-indexed date, page
counts.
2. Q&A Thread View - left: thread list; center: conversation with inline citations; right
(collapsible): source viewer.
3. Source Viewer Panel - renders the actual PDF page with the cited passage highlighted.
4. Admin/Quality Dashboard - RAGAS scores over time, ingestion status, query volume
trends.
11.3 Interaction Details
Streaming answers token-by-token, with citation chips appearing as they're referenced
(not all at the end).
